text:
Maya (Product): Quick design review — onboarding flow for API keys. want to address a couple of things before tomorrow's demo.
Sam (Design): ok, what's top of list?
Maya (Product): 1) empty state for first-time users — current mock says 'Create an API key' but it's buried. need a clearer CTA + microcopy about scopes. 2) rotate/revoke affordances: users confuse rotate vs revoke when they have active integrations. 3) warning hierarchy — severity and placement.
Sam (Design): Agreed. For empty state I propose a two-column layout: left = explanation + primary CTA, right = quick examples (server, client, embed). keeps screen predictable.
Kevin (Eng): two-col is fine but watch mobile. we should collapse to single column under 640px. also, rendering the raw key preview needs to be ephemeral — we can't persist plain text after create.
Maya (Product): yes, ephemeral preview is a must. copy suggestion for create success modal?
Sam (Design): draft copy:
```
Your new API key is ready. This is the only time you’ll see it. Save it now — it grants access scoped to: Read metrics, Create completions.
Show key [button]  •  Copy  •  Done
```
Leah (a11y): wording ok but add sentence about screen readers: "This key will be shown once and then masked" might be clearer than "only time". also ensure the Show key button has aria-expanded state and Copy has aria-live confirmation.
Raj (Support): Need stronger revoke warning when keys are used by live customers. maybe surface last used timestamp + which routes used. customers always ask "who will be impacted?"
Sam (Design): good point — propose inline pill: "Last used 2h ago by account /api/ingest" with a small chevron to reveal recent routes. keep it collapsed by default to avoid noise.
Kevin (Eng): exposing routes has privacy/perf concerns but we can fetch last-5 endpoints from audit logs. that'll be async and show a loading state — see below mock for revoke modal flow.
Maya (Product): Also permission levels: create UI shows scopes toggles. can we show a recommended minimal scope callout? e.g., "Recommended: give only `embeddings.read` unless you need write"
Sam (Design): love the callout. visual treatment: subtle yellow background + info icon. copy: "Recommended minimal scopes reduce blast radius."
Leah (a11y): ensure color contrast meets AA when we use yellow. provide border and icon as non-color indicator.
Kevin (Eng): small technical nit: rotate should be primary action only when the key is not used by active integrations. else we show rotate+grace period info. rotate flow will create a new key and mark old key as deprecated for X days. need to confirm default grace period (7 days?)
Maya (Product): propose default 3 days for public-facing keys, 7 days for internal. but this should be editable in Dedicated/Private.
Raj (Support): Capture a quick FAQ line in modal: "What happens to existing sessions?" -> "Sessions using the old key will stop unless they swap to the new key during the grace period."
Sam (Design): small copy tweak for revoke CTA: replace "Revoke key" (destructive red) with "Revoke permanently" in modal heading + secondary action "Temporarily disable" if we support soft-disable.
Leah (a11y): make sure focus order in modals: title -> reason input -> confirm checkbox "I understand" -> primary button. keyboard users must be able to cancel with Esc.
Kevin (Eng): ack. I'll add keyboard hooks. note: we should avoid inline confirm checkboxes for screen reader clumsiness; prefer a required text input like typing the word REVOKE? open to suggestions.
Maya (Product): Let's keep checkbox for now but test with a11y team. if failed, escalate to typed confirmation.
deploy-bot: Deployed design-sprint branch to staging — /keys UI updated. Tests: unit + e2e.
Raj (Support): I'll test the staging flow with a couple of support tickets and send notes. please tag me when staging link is ready.
Sam (Design): I'll drop updated frames in Figma and add accessibility annotations. tagging @Leah for review.
Leah (a11y): I'll do a pass tomorrow morning, specifically on the empty state, show/copy interactions, and modal focus.
Maya (Product): Thanks team — action items: Sam: updated mocks + yellow callout treatment. Kevin: mobile collapse + ephemeral key handling + last-used fetch. Leah: a11y checklist. Raj: support testcases. Demo tomorrow 11:00 PDT.
Sam (Design): noted.
Kevin (Eng): noted.
Leah (a11y): noted.
Raj (Support): noted. :thumbsup:
